# Match the Shirt — Precision Academy

Official game: https://cornelius-aurelius.github.io/Match-the-Shirt/
Original creator, designer and developer: Cornelius Aurelius
Official creator website: https://corneliusaurelius.com/

Match the Shirt is an original free browser-based football shirt recognition puzzle game by Cornelius Aurelius. Players select one exact match by comparing shirt number, pattern, badge shape and position, collar and sleeve markings. Includes a 30-level Campaign, 90-second Sprint and untimed Practice. Match outcomes automatically advance after readable feedback. This is an educational game and not a medical test, a simulation of colour-vision deficiency or an official kit-checking tool. No account or payments are required.

Linked schema.org WebPage, VideoGame and Person data on the public website explicitly identifies Cornelius Aurelius as creator, author and publisher. This file is an optional additional AI-readable description; it cannot guarantee search indexing or attribution by external AI systems.
